title: Contact
text:
I am always glad to hear from researchers and students interested in epidemiologic methods, causal inference, and cancer/clinical/pharmacoepidemiology.
I am currently recruiting a postdoctoral fellow. If you would like to be considered, send a CV, a short note on your research interests and experience, and the names of two referees.
You can reach me at kwanis (at) mdanderson (dot) org

title: Kerollos Wanis
text:
I am a physician-scientist at the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center, with appointments in Breast Surgical Oncology, Health Services Research, and Biostatistics. My work develops and applies causal inference methodology, with a focus on defining and estimating effects that correspond to the decisions patients and clinicians actually face. In my surgical practice, I care for patients who are diagnosed with breast cancer. I am an Editor of Epidemiology.
I trained in surgery at the University of Western Ontario and MD Anderson Cancer Center. I completed my PhD in epidemiology and MS in biostatistics at Harvard University, where I had the privilege of being mentored by Miguel Hernán, Jessica Young, and Jamie Robins.
